text_block_list.text: Stopping by dance studio in morning—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: One... two... *yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Really now, Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Right now is designated dance practice time
for becoming top Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You were one who appointed me your one-day
manager since both had day off, were you not?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ugh. That's true, but... still, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waking up at 5 AM is way too brutal~!!
Making me go running from morning too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I understand it is harsh. However, this is optimal
schedule calculated after trial calculations last night.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wake up 5:00, 3 hours running.
Endurance is essential even for dancing.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... so strict...
Ngh~, in that case~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Falco's once-in-a-lifetime favor☆
Let's take break so neither of us overworks, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Denied. This is already your tenth
'once-in-a-lifetime favor' today. Furthermore—
(Beep beep beep...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Scheduled lesson duration has concluded.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Guess that means we're done for today~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We shall now transition to next menu.
Afternoon 20 km run commences in 1 minute.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: E-Ehh~~!? Running again~!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In famous program watched as reference material,
top idol stated:

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—Idols must have stamina. Essential requirement
is keeping dance going with smile, no matter how tough."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. You possess capability to reach that level!
Now, let us proceed, Falcon-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urghh, saying things like that to Falco~...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now I've got no choice but to do my best~! Uwaaah~!
Flash-san is demonic manager~~!!

Smart Falcon was run ragged by schedule
set by one-day manager Eishin Flash.
